events.title: 리버풀 beat 첼시 on penalties in the Champions League semi-final at Anfield after both sides won their home leg 1–0.
맨체스터 유나이티드's hopes of an all-English European Cup final with 리버풀 and second Treble are ended when they lose 3–0 to AC 밀란 in the semi-final second leg at the San Siro .
리즈 유나이티드 are relegated to League One for the first time in their history after they go into administration .

맨체스터 유나이티드 come out on top in the Manchester derby beating 맨체스터 시티 1–0. In doing so United extend their lead at the top of the Premiership to 8 points. City's failure to score means that they set a new record for the fewest goals scored at home in a season by a club in the top flight, with only 10 scored in the season. 브리스틀 시티 are promoted to the Championship. Boston United are relegated to the Conference. 스윈던 타운 are promoted to League One and 월솔 are League Two champions. 밀턴킨스 던스 moved out of the National Hockey Stadium and into stadium:mk
맨체스터 유나이티드 win the Premiership after 첼시 only draw 1–1 at 아스널 . 선덜랜드 win the Championship with a 5–0 win at 루턴 타운 , whilst 버밍엄 시티 lose 1–0 at 프레스턴 노스 엔드 .

아스널 Ladies completed an unprecedented Quadruple of trophies, defeating 찰턴 애슬레틱 4–1 in the FA Women's Cup final, to add to their FA Women's Premier League , Women's League Cup and UEFA Women's Cup victories. 찰턴 애슬레틱 are relegated from the Premiership after they lose to 토트넘 홋스퍼 .

셰필드 유나이티드 are relegated from the Premiership after losing 2–1 at home to 위건 애슬레틱 and 웨스트햄 유나이티드 beat 맨체스터 유나이티드 1–0 at Old Trafford. The season ends with 맨체스터 유나이티드 champions, 첼시 runners-up and 리버풀 and 아스널 completing the top four. 토트넘 홋스퍼, 에버턴 and Bolton all qualify for the UEFA Cup.
Neil Warnock resigns after seven and a half years in charge of 셰필드 유나이티드.

The Football League confirms that Boston United were docked ten points for entering a Company Voluntary Arrangement in the final seconds of their League Two defeat at 렉섬 , a game which saw The Pilgrims relegated.
첼시 beat 맨체스터 유나이티드 1–0 to win the FA Cup . at the first FA Cup Final at the new Wembley and stop 맨체스터 유나이티드 winning the double.

Romário scores his 1000th goal for 바스쿠 다 가마 by penalty kick against Sport Recife . He is only the second player in the history of professional soccer to achieve this, the first being Pelé in 1969 . (Uol)
모어컴 are promoted to the Football League for the first time in their history after beating 엑서터 시티 2–1 in the Conference National play-off final.
